title: Attributes
description: This plugin for Paper 1.21.11 adds a new way of trading attributes
body:
# Attributes

This Minecraft Paper plugin was made for 1.21.11 and it adds a new way to trade for Attributes

The concept is very simple... You can give you're height to people and people can give it to you.
It was inspired by TeddyPlayer1's [TitanCivilisation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4tiiPo6YcXg)

## Commands

### /give<attribute> <player> <amount>
  Gives the specivied amount of the attribute to a player

### /view<attribute> <player - optional>
  Let's you see you're attribute or the attribute of another player if you're an admin

### /take<attribute> <player> <amount> - just for admins
  Takes the specivied amount from the player

## Setup

After the first Plugin start there will be a new folder with a file under plugins/attribues/**config.yml** open it in a text Editor. The **default will be SCALE** with changes you're height.
You can replace that with:

- SCALE
- MAX_HEALTH
- MOVEMENT_SPEED
- ATTACK_DAMAGE

after that restart the Server or type /reload in chat to change the attribute type
